explication: Zstandard is a lossless compression library with a command-line file utility and compatibility interfaces. The principal workflow is: a user or application supplies bytes or files; the CLI or public API configures compression/decompression, optionally loads a dictionary, processes blocks through entropy coding, and returns compressed or restored data. The tree also shows parallel compression, dictionary training, legacy decoding, seekable framing, and zlib-compatible integration. Some subsystem links are inferred only from documented APIs because many implementations were not sampled.
